常见问题

如何联系支持？

点击邮箱按钮，描述问题，并附上设备型号、iOS 版本、App 版本和操作步骤。截图或 PHH 文件可按需附上，请先检查其中是否包含你不想分享的信息。

筹码可以兑现吗？

筹码仅用于单机 AI 对战，没有现金价值，不能兑换现金或现实奖品。当前版本没有筹码充值或付费重置功能。

练习次数和续局如何计算？

每天可开 3 次练习桌，按设备当地日期于次日零点恢复。开桌扣一次；离开后 5 分钟内可继续原桌，不重复扣次数。超过时间原桌作废，次数不退。

清空生涯会删除什么？

商店版累计提供 1 次免费重置，将资金恢复为 2,000 筹码，保留已解锁档位、成就和牌局记录。次数不自动恢复；破产不会自动补充筹码。牌局记录可以在设置中单独清空。

锦标赛可以中途退出吗？

可以退出并恢复原桌。主动离开扣除未投入底池的比赛筹码的 20%；后台停留达到 5 分钟后返回也扣一次。只有认输或比赛结束才结束该场比赛。

如何导出牌局？

在 App 的牌局记录中打开相应牌局，使用 PHH 导出功能，再选择保存或分享目标。

Support

For help, bug reports or privacy questions, email mixmin2000@gmail.com. Include your device model, iOS version, app version and steps to reproduce the issue. Review screenshots or PHH files before sharing them.

Chips and career resets

Chips are for offline AI games only. They have no cash value and cannot be redeemed for money or real-world prizes. The current version has no chip purchases or paid resets. The App Store version provides one free career reset to 2,000 chips, keeping unlocked stakes, achievements and hand history. The allowance does not renew and bankruptcy does not automatically refill chips.

Practice sessions

You can start three practice tables per local calendar day. Allowances renew at local midnight. Return within five minutes after leaving to resume the same table at no additional cost. After that, the table expires and the entry is not refunded.

Tournaments

Leaving preserves the table and deducts 20% of your uncommitted tournament chips. Returning after five minutes in the background also triggers one deduction. A tournament ends when you concede or finish playing.

Hand history and privacy

Open a recorded hand to export it in PHH format, then choose where to save or share it. You can clear hand history separately in Settings. Read the Privacy Policy for details about local data and exports.
